Checked in so a local `pyright` from the repo root and the CI `python-types`
job report the SAME set. Run it with the pinned version:  make types
Pinned version: pyright 1.1.411, named here, in .github/workflows/ci.yml and
in the Makefile's `types` target. Keep the three in step.
WHY THE FILE SET IS LISTED AND NOT GLOBBED. scripts/ holds 112 Python files.
Most are research code that imports numpy, pandas, duckdb, pyarrow, torch or
ydf; checking them would need the whole ML stack installed on every pull
request to produce mostly unresolved-import noise (81 of the 126 errors a
tree-wide run reports are reportMissingImports). The files below are the ones
that DECIDE something — the fixture/bar resolver, the headline scorer, and the
gates CI already runs on every PR — and every one of them is stdlib-only, so
this configuration needs no dependency install and cannot drift from a local
Adding a script here is cheap and is the right move whenever a new script
starts resolving a bar, a score or a gate verdict. Adding one that imports a
third party is not: install it in the workflow first, or the job reports an
unresolved import instead of a type error.
